title: solar.terrain.placement.request/1 (DRAFT for review)
description: Place an immutable Module 01 layout result on a stored terrain surface by rigid vertical lift. All lengths in metres. Every parameter that changes the result is explicit; there are no hidden defaults.

source_layout.description: The Module 01 result, named by its result ID and payload digest together. Table IDs such as T_j0_i0 are unique only inside this layout.

terrain.description: A stored terrain ID (ter_...). Fixture files may name a surface file instead; the service stores it first and uses its ID.

vertical.description: Optional assertion: the caller expects results in this vertical reference. A different terrain vertical reference is DATUM_MISMATCH; nothing is transformed.

policy.description: Rigid vertical translation of each table, keeping its XY footprint, tilt, azimuth and module layout. The lift is the smallest that keeps the vertical clearance at least minimum_clearance_m over the whole footprint.

structure_depth_m.description: Depth of structure below the module plane counted against clearance; 0 measures clearance to the module plane.

supports.description: Support positions come from an explicitly stated model; their number is not derived from table dimensions or module count.

model.description: Supports at d in rows_d_m and a = end_offset_a_m + k * spacing_a_m for k = 0.. while a <= W - end_offset_a_m.

coverage.description: A table whose footprint is not wholly inside the TIN coverage is reported as unknown_ground and not placed. No interpolation across gaps and no extrapolation.
